functions.comment: [SEP-01.2] ECX unit+164 bridge, 4 stack args (enable, selector, category, rank), RET 10. Resolves handle [ecx+8]/[ecx+c] with PathRegistry_ResolveCanonical (plain RET leaves the re-pushed args) and calls Mover_ConfigureSeparation, which consumes them. SEP-01.2

functions.name: Separate_Update
functions.comment: Cooldown first; apply retained endpoint displacement; accumulate ordered outward pairs with owner RNG on tiny overlap; damp/deadzone/cap. Original shipped initializer rows,600 pair105 tail slices match C705 words. Engine owner scheduler/idle pair/Save66 ported. Public101 two-member full composition verifies830 owner visits/1361 commits; request-speed c0>0 clears source vector and installs cooldown7 after countdown, c0!=0 rejects candidate.13 overlaps and91 retries interleave one owner stream. Payoff132/SEP-02.2: production ordered proximity composition matches all3055 complete T-phase visits and2439 individual neighbor calls in global captured order across27 units, including the zero-contribution T2/T5 cross-cluster calls. Every pair identity/pose/vector/RNG word and complete endpoint/vector/cooldown/fine rectangle matches. [SEP-01.2] SEP-01.2: selector = byte[sep+22]&15; rows 5..15 are all-zero words: no accumulation, tail zeroes the vector and never installs cooldown (original oracle + live hS05 pairs), yet the d<0.001 branch still consumes one owner draw per overlapping candidate per visit. Payoff133/SEP-02.3/SEP-04.1: complete O-phase engine composition matches2546 visits,1882 individual ordered neighbor calls,1476 shared owner draws and all pose/vector/policy/cooldown/endpoint/occupancy words across nine groups. All20 units share one owner stream; neither exact-overlap pairs nor selector-zero draws may be isolated or reordered. Both repeated full Frida captures replay all original pair/tail bodies exactly.

functions.name: Mover_ConfigureSeparation
functions.comment: Destroy existing separation; if enabled allocate, bind mover, set selector/category/rank and register. Gameplay caller693d50 via05c9c0; serialization/destruction callers too. [SEP-01.2] SEP-01.2: setters run selector 171040, category 1710c0, rank 1711e0; original oracle 65,536 cases: word=(prior&ffff)|(sel&15)<<16|(cat&ff)<<20|(rank&15)<<28; selector high nibble is overwritten by the category setter. enable!=0 (any int) allocates; callers 05c9dc (refresh), 16eb59 (destroy, all zero), 16f82a (load: enable from stream, then sep vtable+30 restore).

functions.comment: Enabled66fc50; UnitBalance repulseParam selector+228, repulseGroup+22c, repulsePrio+230.695090 owner685da0 high nibble, flag60.1 override15, group low nibble. Original producer category1024 cases; engine authored nonstock policy and saved membership tested. Extra runtime disable/override producers remain open. [SEP-01.2] SEP-01.2: refresh triggers (call/jmp sites): unit init 68a4f5 (CUnit slot+1ac), type rebind 670d4d, SetPlayerOwner 698f88 (skipped if same owner), suspend events d0145/d0146 69c493/69c583 (live PauseUnit), CancelAllOrders path 67e0e3, suppression acquire/release jmp 688d96/6785c6, channel work begin/end jmp 48ef47/48bca7 (live ANcl clone). Only AL of 695130/6951a0 is stored; pushed dword upper bytes are uninitialized and ignored by setters. Flag60 is mask 0x1 (bit 0), see 695090.

functions.name: Unit_OnSuspendBeginEvent
functions.comment: [SEP-01.2] CUnit event 0xd0145 (handler 690490, vtable 6fb77eb0 slot+c). Refresh first (Unit+5c 0x200000 already set by PauseUnit), then if Unit+54>0 set 5c 0x100000 and Unit_AcquireSeparationSuppression. Live PauseUnit(true). SEP-01.2

functions.name: Unit_OnSuspendEndEvent
functions.comment: [SEP-01.2] CUnit event 0xd0146. Refresh first (still suppressed), then if 5c 0x100000 clear it and JMP Unit_ReleaseSeparationSuppression (second refresh re-enables). Live PauseUnit(false). SEP-01.2
